subject: CS475
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering all topics. For 'Version Control' and 'Git CLI', top-tier, highly-viewed tutorials were available in both languages. For 'GitHub Collaboration', the Arabic selection focused on the pull request workflow due to a lack of comprehensive videos on merge conflicts. For the niche topic 'Saudi Digital Library', selections were made based on the best available candidates, using the low-view-count exception for the English video.

coverage.note: Most candidates were for general CLI, not Git-specific, failing relevance gate.
No single video covered both collaboration and conflicts well. Selected the best eligible video for the collaboration (Pull Request) part.
Several candidates failed the duration or language gates.
No candidate reached 3000 views; selected the highest-view video over 500 per exception rule.
